summary.zh-CN: 围绕复视和进行性下肢无力，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。
summary.en: Review the evidence, competing explanations and next steps for diplopia and progressive leg weakness.

text.zh-CN: 新斯的明试验阴性；存在反复呕吐和偏食，无法开展维生素 B1 定量。
text.en: Neostigmine test was negative; recurrent vomiting and selective eating were present, but quantitative thiamine testing was unavailable.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 原报告给维生素 B1 后 1 周复视、头晕和眼肌活动改善，可走数米；1 个月下肢肌力 V 级，MRI 报告正常。
text.en: After thiamine, diplopia, dizziness and ocular movements improved within a week and he could walk a few metres. At one month leg strength was grade V and MRI was reported normal.

text.zh-CN: 硫胺素缺乏性脑病的临床可能
text.en: Clinical suspicion of thiamine-deficiency encephalopathy

feedback.zh-CN: 营养风险、眼征及对称 MRI 支持。
feedback.en: Nutritional risk, ocular signs and symmetric MRI support it.

text.zh-CN: 因没有饮酒史就排除 Wernicke 型脑病
text.en: No alcohol history excludes Wernicke-type encephalopathy

feedback.zh-CN: 儿童营养缺乏也可相关。
feedback.en: Nutritional deficiency can occur in children.

text.zh-CN: 所有复视无力都是重症肌无力
text.en: Every case of diplopia and weakness is myasthenia

feedback.zh-CN: 意识改变和脑内影像需另作解释。
feedback.en: Mental-status and brain-imaging findings need another explanation.

prompt.zh-CN: 没有定量结果时怎样处理？
prompt.en: What should happen without a quantitative result?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 儿科团队及时给予疑似缺乏的硫胺素治疗评估，同时调查营养与其他病因
text.en: The paediatric team promptly assesses thiamine treatment while investigating nutrition and alternatives

feedback.zh-CN: 不应仅为等待不可及检测而延误可逆病因处理。
feedback.en: Unavailable testing should not alone delay care for a potentially reversible cause.

text.zh-CN: 等能测到维生素浓度再处理
text.en: Wait until vitamin testing becomes available

feedback.zh-CN: 可能延误神经恢复机会。

text.zh-CN: 一律禁止任何救命葡萄糖
text.en: Always withhold life-saving glucose

feedback.zh-CN: 怀疑缺乏不能成为延误低血糖救治的理由。
feedback.en: Suspected deficiency does not justify delaying hypoglycaemia rescue.

prompt.zh-CN: 改善后可怎样表达诊断？
prompt.en: How should diagnosis be expressed after improvement?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 改善加强临床判断，但缺少直接 B1 测定，结肠切除致吸收障碍也未单独证明
text.en: Improvement strengthens clinical suspicion, but direct B1 confirmation and colectomy-related malabsorption are unproven

feedback.zh-CN: 不能把有风险因素改写成测得缺乏。
feedback.en: Risk factors are not measured deficiency.

text.zh-CN: 已经完成 B1 浓度确诊
text.en: A B1 concentration confirmed the diagnosis

text.en: MRI recovery proves colectomy was the sole cause

feedback.zh-CN: 还存在呕吐与摄入不足。
feedback.en: Vomiting and poor intake are additional factors.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 营养风险与神经影像提示硫胺素缺乏性脑病，治疗后改善支持临床判断但无直接定量确证。
conclusion.en: Nutritional risks and neuroimaging suggested thiamine-deficiency encephalopathy; improvement supported the clinical impression without direct measurement.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
